Package it.polimi.ingsw.controller.messages

Class StartGameMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.messages.Message
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.messages.ConnectionAckMessage
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.messages.StartGameMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ReconnectionMessage
public class StartGameMessage extends ConnectionAckMessage
Message that needs to be sent, to all players, when the number of the connected players has reached the number of players that was established by the player that created the game
